trust_decision.summary: Advisory: WidgetSelect::processFormData must never unserialize() a client-submitted multiple-select value. At the pinned commit it already takes the value as an array and keeps only scalars, so the protection is already in place. The listed fix commit changes something unrelated (PostgreSQL connect-error reporting in the Installer).

landing_point.why: The summary names WidgetSelect, and processFormData is where submitted form values reach the model.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: File cache get() calls unserialize() with no allowed_classes on file contents.
